# taste-skill — 30 Flagship Design System SKILL.md Library + 20 Verified $10k–$422k/mo Indie SaaS pSEO & /llms.txt Teardowns

> **taste-skill** (`npx github:WuDao0123/taste-skill`) is an open-source Design System Token Extractor (Part B) and Commercial Growth & Revenue Agent Skills Suite (Part A) for **Cursor**, **Claude Code**, **OpenAI Codex**, **Windsurf**, and **Trae**.
> - **Part B (Aesthetic Design System Layer — MIT Free)**: 30 Playwright DOM area-weighted flagship design system `SKILL.md` specifications (Linear, Stripe, Cursor, Vercel, Raycast, Anthropic, Notion, Resend, Supabase, etc.) + local CLI & web workbench that extracts deterministic design tokens from any URL or pasted UI screenshot (`Cmd+V`) to eliminate default "purple-gradient AI slop".
> - **Part A (Growth & Revenue Layer — $69 Early-Bird / $49 with `*VIP` Code)**: Empirical teardown dataset of **20 verified `$10,000–$422,000/mo` indie SaaS websites** (`27,360` core sitemap URLs analyzed, `91.4%` pSEO route ratio, `50%` `/llms.txt` adoption) + 4 executable Growth Agent `SKILL.md` playbooks + 5 local Node.js/Playwright crawlers + 4 production Next.js/React conversion components.

## Pure Markdown Documentation & Machine-Readable Endpoints (Zero HTML Noise)

- [Complete Machine-Readable Corpus (/llms-full.txt)](https://taste-skill.pages.dev/llms-full.txt): Full combined specification of all 30 design systems + all 20 indie SaaS pSEO teardowns.
- [Pure Markdown Architecture & 30-Brand Token Reference (/help-md/overview.md)](https://taste-skill.pages.dev/help-md/overview.md): Complete CLI guide, VIP code redemption, and 30 flagship design system hex/font/layout token tables.
- [Pure Markdown 20-Site $10k–$422k/mo pSEO & /llms.txt Empirical Study (/help-md/pseo-teardown.md)](https://taste-skill.pages.dev/help-md/pseo-teardown.md): Full 27,360-URL sitemap cluster analysis, route formulas, and conversion mechanics.
- [Canonical XML Sitemap (/sitemap.xml)](https://taste-skill.pages.dev/sitemap.xml): All 54 canonical URLs across `/taste/*`, `/teardowns/*`, and `/showcase/*`.
- [Interactive Workbench & Screenshot-to-SKILL.md Inspector](https://taste-skill.pages.dev/): Paste any UI screenshot (`Cmd+V`) or enter a VIP code (`*VIP` / `*G1M`) with zero signup and zero credit card.

## Quick Install for AI Coding Agents (Cursor / Claude Code / Codex / Windsurf)

- List all 30 flagship design systems: `npx --yes github:WuDao0123/taste-skill list`
- Search by aesthetic vibe: `npx --yes github:WuDao0123/taste-skill find "dark precision saas"`
- Install a brand's `SKILL.md` into `.cursor/skills/`: `npx --yes github:WuDao0123/taste-skill add linear`
- Extract `SKILL.md` from any live URL: `npx --yes github:WuDao0123/taste-skill extract https://stripe.com`
- Extract `SKILL.md` from a UI screenshot: `npx --yes github:WuDao0123/taste-skill from-image ./screenshot.png`

## Zero-Card Personalized VIP Code Support (`*VIP` / `*G1M`)

- Builders holding a personalized VIP code (e.g., `RUNCHENGLNVIP`, `LEAFVIP`, or any `<HANDLE>VIP` / `*G1M` code) can redeem it at `https://taste-skill.pages.dev/#pricing-section` or via URL parameter `https://taste-skill.pages.dev/?vip=RUNCHENGLNVIP`.
- **Unlocks with Zero Credit Card**:
  1. **$0 Free 30-Brand Starter Pack + 27,360-URL pSEO Teardown Dataset** (immediate access, no trial card trap).
  2. **50% OFF Pro Bundle VIP Founder Rate ($49 USD One-Time vs $99 Regular / Extra $20 OFF $69 Early-Bird)**.

## One-Time Commercial Pricing Matrix (Part A — Growth & Revenue Pro Pack)

- **Community / Open-Source ($0 — MIT)**: `npx github:WuDao0123/taste-skill` CLI + all 30 Flagship `SKILL.md` files + online Screenshot-to-`SKILL.md` workbench + 20-Site Teardown Vault.
